mobbin:7c04e7a5-ee31-4531-9e1a-fc413f10c.summary: From a timestamped transcript playback view the user enters edit mode, corrects a word inline with the keyboard while the scrubber stays available, then exits with the corrected selection visible.
steps: Edit mode — select typo MVCreally, keyboard up
Edit mode — cursor in highlighted phrase, Done in header
View mode — MVP really selected, pencil in header
steal: Speaker block + start timestamp on every paragraph (step 1) — ties text to audio without a separate timeline UI.
Floating playback bar above the keyboard while editing (steps 2–3) — scrub/±5s without leaving edit.
Explicit Done vs pencil header states (steps 2–4) — clear enter/exit for inline transcript correction.
Highlighter / comment / image actions on the player (step 1) — same moment can be marked while correcting text.
avoid: Dense metadata header (keywords, speakers, share) above the transcript (step 1) — competes with glanceable playback for gloved faculty.
mobbin:7c04e7a5-ee31-4531-9e1a-fc413f10c.fit: Mobile wins for post-session transcript fix-ups beside the recording; extends Baseline timestamped speech-to-text notes and can feed private debrief moments — not a live-room control replacement.

mobbin:6915b30a-9982-4888-a599-f263dc314.summary: From transcript playback the user opens the + tray, chooses Comment, composes a reply anchored to a timestamp chip, and sees it land in a threaded view.
steps: + tray — Comment / Take photo / Add Image
Comment sheet — snippet + 24:16 pin chip + Add Reply
steal: Timestamp pin chip on the comment sheet (steps 3–5) — always shows which moment the note belongs to.
+ tray grouping Comment with photo capture (step 2) — one entry for moment evidence.
Snippet of transcript above the compose field (steps 3–4) — context without leaving the thread.
Comment count badge next to the timestamp chip after post (step 5) — glanceable proof the annotation stuck.
avoid: Starting the add path from a small + on the player (step 2) — easy to miss for one-hand/gloved use; prefer a larger Add comment target.
mobbin:6915b30a-9982-4888-a599-f263dc314.fit: Mobile beats fixed SRV for private timestamped faculty notes during playback; maps directly to Baseline debrief-annotations (prefer web page for shared big-screen control).
